"PW_Group_20261105_100236_w12r091106x" is priced Free and rendered as "Free to Follow", so it cannot be joined — but PG-01 proved this leader's Stripe IS connected, and a $0 group on a payable leader is still supposed to charge the member $3/month. Check the leader's hosting plan first (a lapsed plan makes every group of theirs follow-only regardless of price), then their Earnings/withdrawal setup.
MEMBER: FREE group offers Join, not Follow
Join CTA should be visible in side panel getByTestId('group-side-panel').locator('button, a, [role="button"]').filter({ hasText: /Join|Interested|Get|Subscribe|Pay|Activate/i }).first()
The join CTA should read "Join Group" on a group priced Free. It read "Join Group". The label does not vary by pricing model — if it now does, the product changed.

A group priced Free should show "$3/month" beside its join CTA (its price plus the $3 platform fee). The member saw "$3/month" — either the leader's pricing is not reaching them, or the price display changed again.
MEMBER: FREE group discloses the $3 fee in the side panel (reported)
Side panel should offer the "Show platform fee details" affordance beside the price getByTestId('group-side-panel').getByLabel('Show platform fee details').first()

Hovering "Show platform fee details" should show the platform fee tooltip ("Includes the $3/month MentalHappy platform fee") — the only place the member learns what the price includes getByRole('tooltip').filter({ hasText: 'Includes the $3/month MentalHappy platform fee' }).first()
MEMBER: FREE join routes to checkout - a $0 group is still a money path
Join CTA should be visible in side panel getByTestId('group-side-panel').locator('button, a, [role="button"]').filter({ hasText: /Join|Interested|Get|Subscribe|Pay|Activate/i }).first()

A group priced Free must still route the member to checkout, because the $3 platform fee is charged on top of a $0 group price. Landing on the group page instead means the fee was not collected — either the product changed, or free groups stopped being a money path. Re-check the leader's pricing page: its Live Preview is what settled this ("Your Price $0.00 / Platform Monthly Fee $3.00 / Total Member Pays $3.00/month").
